diagrams.title: Compose a temporal projection
diagrams.summary: The host composes explicit track contributions over a caller-owned subject, while Timeline owns only its derived projection and local surface state.

nodes.label: Canonical subject
nodes.description: The temporal subject remains under its upstream authority.

nodes.label: Timeline projection
nodes.description: Contributions translate the subject into readable tracks.

nodes.label: Timeline intent
nodes.description: A position, range or selection change is requested.

nodes.label: Surface state
nodes.description: The reducer updates the local reading state.

nodes.label: Viewport projection
nodes.description: Projection-local bounds, scale, grid and pointer coordinates are derived without changing the subject.

nodes.label: Sample
nodes.description: A value is read at a given temporal coordinate.

diagrams.caption: A Timeline projection can be removed or reconfigured without changing the subject or its semantic revision.
